name: Starbrew Station: The Galactic Tycoon Unit
summary: The Galactic Tycoon is an aspirational Patron unit for the VIP Deck (Deck 5), designed for dedicated late-game players. This unit offers a powerful new income source, producing 40,000 Coffee/s, surpassing the standard free units on this deck. It provides an extra goal for those who wish to accelerate their prestige runs and offers another way to support the solo developer.
